The advantages of total reflecting prism over plane mirror are: a• When light is reflected from total reflecting prism, whole of the light is totally internally reflected. However, from plane mirror, only about 90% of 'incident light is reflected.

Therefore, intensity of reflected light is more -in' prism than that of the light reflected from plane mirror. b• No multiple reflections take place in total reflecting prism as in plane mirror. e image is not laterally inverted in case of total reflecting prism as in plane mirror.
